drag.rs.review: Press-scoped drag claim and mounted kept rectangles use the proved timestamp predicate.

interaction/mod.rs.review: Owner adapter: observes the proved lease before cloning a payload; only explicit store renews ownership.

widgets/button.rs.review: Press-scoped hold progress/reporting state; a fresh press cannot inherit old completion.

widgets/dropdown.rs.review: Mounted open/query state; explicit cancellation retires owned areas and search focus.

widgets/dropdown/popup.rs.review: Mounted open/query state; explicit cancellation retires owned areas and search focus.

widgets/list_row.rs.review: Press-scoped long-press state and release suppression.

widgets/number_field.rs.review: Mounted numeric draft; current caller value also validates the draft seed.

widgets/pattern_pad.rs.review: Press-scoped trace ownership; caller-owned secret path is not cached.

widgets/progress.rs.review: Paint-only progress high-water and beat history; no input admission.

widgets/progress_ring.rs.review: Paint-only tessellated mesh cache; no input admission.

widgets/text_field.rs.review: Mounted keyboard request and password reveal state.

widgets/unroll.rs.review: Geometry history used by expandable content; affects clipping and needs separate layout/input refinement.

widgets/wheel.rs.review: Mounted animation and separate fresh-press capture admission; expiration seeds from current caller selection.
